pages.text: “Blooming under the scorching sun, its fiery petals carry the power of protection.”$(br2)Safflower Tea is a heat-infused beverage made from dried safflower petals and sugar. The tea has a vibrant orange-red hue. Drinking it grants Fire Resistance and the Desert Walker effect, allowing travelers to move more easily in hot environments.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Safflower Tea, $(br)boil dried safflower petals with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed in hot terrains or fiery environments, increasing survivability in extreme conditions.

Upon drinking Safflower Tea, travelers gain Fire Resistance and the Desert Walker effect, allowing them to navigate flames and desert landscapes with ease.$(br)This tea is perfect for high-temperature environments.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
